title: 039 NNPredict -- combined sizer (user request 2026-10-21: 'try the combined sizer'): cs_aro's width book sized by the mean of ARO's p_buy percentile and the excursion-H32 Ridge's predicted-move percentile (cs_mix's design)
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); halves are the persistence test (constitution gate 2). Nothing is adopted by this stage; adoption is the user's call.

cs_aro_nnp.change: cs_aro with sizer_score = 0.5 * (pct(ARO p_buy) + pct(exc32 %predict_gain)), each percentile against the fold's validation-tail width-book run starts; per-fold 0.5-share threshold (hgb_sizer pick, cs_mix's rule); model key, framework_sha (7de225f72b71eef4), entries and stakes = cs_aro's

instrument_rules.mix_table_check.json: the exc32 tables reproduce nnp_ridge_exc32_op_csa's in-backtest agree tags on >= 99% of its 930 trades, <= 1% missing
instrument_rules.mix_verify.json: every fold: hgb_sizer verify (each validation-tail width-book tag == mixed score > the stored threshold) and no tail_leak_pairs

instrument: per arm: a record for all 15 folds, model trained per fold on its training window (run_folds strict artefact check), and trades in both halves; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (no P&L read)
alone: judge_one(arm, comparator) with the rule maps; liveness: an arm whose trades change on no fold vs its comparator is INERT (a defect)

decision.cs_aro_nnp: PASS vs cs_aro (both halves gain, paired not WORSENED) -> the combined sizer beats NNNC's reference sizer (candidate; adoption is the user's call). FAIL -> cs_aro stays the reference; the vs-w_aro / vs-csa / vs-cs_mix rows are reported

seen_before: follow-ups 3: nnp_ridge_exc32_op_csa 57.01 vs w_aro 51.44 (IMPROVED p 0.028), vs cs_aro 59.95 (early -3.77 / late +0.84)
the exc32 screen: rho 0.36 with cs_aro's p_buy on early width-book trades
cs_mix (ARO + 037 composite, same design) 61.07: vs cs_aro -0.58 / +1.70 FAIL; its forward window lost
why: the exc32 score and ARO's p_buy are partly independent (rho 0.36) and each sizes the width book on its own; cs_mix's equal-weight percentile mean is the existing, untuned way to combine two sizer scores. Nothing tuned: weights 0.5/0.5, knots and threshold rule as cs_mix.
caveat: the combination was chosen after seeing both components' 15-fold results; one era, one seed
